text: May 6 (Reuters) - Iran has not yet responded to the latest U.S. proposal aimed at ending the more than two-month war, Iran's Tasnim news agency said on Wednesday, citing an unnamed source who added that the draft contained some unacceptable provisions.
translated_text: 路透5月6日 - 伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社周三援引一位不愿透露姓名的消息人士的话称，伊朗尚未对美国旨在结束两个多月战争的最新提议做出回应，该消息人士补充说，该草案包含一些不可接受的条款。

text: The U.S. and Iran are nearing an agreement on a “one-page memorandum” to end the war and a framework for talks on the nuclear program, a source familiar with the talks tells me@NewsNationFirst reported by@axios@BarakRavidThe US expects responses from Iran within 48
translated_text: 一位熟悉谈判的消息人士告诉我，美国和伊朗即将就结束战争的“一页备忘录”和核计划谈判框架达成协议。美国预计伊朗将在 48 天内做出回应

text: NEW President Trump says if Iran “agrees to give what has been agreed to” then the military operation and blockade in the Strait of Hormuz ends. He says if they don’t the bombing starts.
translated_text: 新总统特朗普表示，如果伊朗“同意给予已达成的协议”，那么霍尔木兹海峡的军事行动和封锁就会结束。他说，如果他们不这样做，轰炸就会开始。
